title: Moving to another state - DMV boundary
facts: Driver licenses, vehicle titles, vehicle registration, inspection and ordinary auto-insurance requirements are primarily governed by state law.
Deadlines for obtaining a new state driver's license or registering a vehicle after becoming a resident vary by state.
There is no single federal 30-day or 60-day rule that applies to every person moving between U.S. states.
Hanka should identify the destination state before giving a DMV or vehicle-registration deadline.
